evidence.reason: An identical pipeline stays in its serving generation. After a valid replacement fails to bind, both pipelines deliver through the committed configuration.
The candidate records ingress acceptance and batch admission, then exercises graceful shutdown with the batch outstanding and compares all exported IDs including their multiplicity.
The exact codec case compares nested data after serialization. A missing test or an incomplete grouped result cannot establish a passing guarantee.
Both fan-out admission and completion behavior at the in-flight cap must pass. Each router independently exercises a parked output under asymmetric load.
The component mapping separates shared wire, processor and controller evidence. The exact-ID comparison applies to a healthy local sink at graceful shutdown.

The drain uses receiver responses, a scoped channel counter, a terminal shutdown response and a decoded sink capture. Controller conflict uses an already-active operation. Exact libtest names and nextest class names bind CI and local evidence to the same cases.
The admission barrier reads one data channel of the batch node in the test pipeline. The real sink verifies behavior independently of this metric.
